title: Ferretti Yachts 940: Main-Deck Owner’s Suite and Personalization Set the Tone for the Series
description: Discover the Ferretti Yachts 940 range, where the main-deck owner's suite and flexible design set new standards in semi-custom megayachts.
html:
The Ferretti Yachts 940 range sets a fresh benchmark in the world of semi-custom megayachts, offering a harmonious mix of spaciousness, seclusion, and adaptability. First showcased at the Venice Boat Show, this 95-foot (28.97-meter) flybridge vessel draws inspiration from the Ferretti Yachts 1000, offering spacious accommodations and adaptable layouts for discerning buyers.

Main-Deck Owner’s Suite and Guest Wellbeing

A key feature of the Ferretti Yachts 940 is its expansive full-beam owner’s suite covering almost 300 square feet (27 square meters), situated forward on the main deck. This suite is separate from guest staterooms, prioritizing privacy for the owner. Both the sleeping quarters and en suite make effective use of the yacht’s generous 22-foot (6.76-meter) beam. Panoramic windows and optional sliding glass panels by the dining area ensure a luminous, airy setting, keeping guests closely connected with the surrounding sea even indoors.

Adaptable Interiors and Social Venues

The semi-custom ethos of the 940 series grants owners the ability to personalize the yacht’s interior. There are three saloon layout options: a standard corner settee facing the television, two settees ideal for larger groups, or a design focused on storage solutions. Across these layouts, the TV can be hidden within a wall recess. The vessel sleeps up to 10 guests in five staterooms, making it well-suited for lengthy trips with friends and family.

Open-Air Living and Practical Deck Solutions

Outdoor spaces aboard the Ferretti Yachts 940 are highly customizable. The aft flybridge can be set up for lounging in the sun or arranged with seating, while the hardtop over the central dining and secondary helm station comes in solid or louvered versions. An alfresco galley beneath the hardtop enhances the flybridge’s potential for socializing. On the foredeck, guests will find a lounge and sunpad area fitted with integrated glass holders, and a 13-foot (4.1-meter) tender stored in the garage can be launched thanks to a submersible swim platform.

Crew Arrangements and Operational Practicality

The main galley sits just forward of the dining area for efficient service. Crew quarters feature private bathrooms for each cabin, while the captain’s cabin can be set up as a single or double. Dedicated crew passageways allow discrete movement between cabins, galley, and the wheelhouse, which benefits from a seamless windshield. The galley’s direct access to the side deck helps with provisioning and logistics.

Power and Style Choices

Owners may opt for the standard twin 2,000-hp MAN engines yielding a cruising speed of 21 knots, or select optional 2,200-hp MAN engines for a top speed of approximately 23 knots. The Ideaeitalia studio provides two distinct interior designs: the Contemporary package inspired by marine hues, and the Classic style with warm, earthy shades.

Ferretti Yachts 940 Series: Key Details

  • Length Overall: 95’1” (28.97 meters)
  • Beam: 22’2” (6.76 meters)
  • Draft: 7’7” (2.3 meters)
  • Guest Accommodation: 10 guests in 5 staterooms
  • Engines: 2 x 2,000-hp MAN (standard) or 2 x 2,200-hp MAN (optional)
  • Shipyard: Ferretti Yachts
  • Exterior Designer: Filippo Salvetti
  • Naval Architecture: Ferretti Group Engineering Department
  • Interior Designer: Ideaeitalia

The Ferretti Yachts 940 range is distinguished by its main-deck owner’s suite, adaptable interiors, and a wealth of customization possibilities, positioning it as a top choice in the semi-custom megayacht segment.
